keyword.zh: 电动10和电动20混凝土泵的区别

title.zh: 电动10和电动20混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: Electric 10 prints 21 m³/h and only 25 m horizontal. Electric 20 prints 8–10 m³/h and 120 m / 40 m.
description.zh: 电动10印 21 m³/h，但只有水平 25 m。电动20印 8–10 m³/h，距离为 120 m / 40 m。

h1.zh: 电动10和电动20混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Electric 10 Series and Electric 20 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 10 prints 15 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.1 m³ and horizontal distance 25 m, with no vertical cell. Electric 20 prints 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, hopper 0.25 m³ and distance 120 m / 40 m. Higher theoretical output on Electric 10 is not a longer distance cell.
directAnswer.zh: 电动10系列和电动20是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。电动10印 15 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.1 m³、水平距离 25 m，没有垂直格。电动20印 22 kW、8–10 m³/h、10 MPa、料斗 0.25 m³、距离 120 m / 40 m。电动10更高的理论输送量并不是更长的距离格。

heading.en: Where Electric 10 Series and Electric 20 print different values
heading.zh: 电动10系列和电动20哪些数值不同

body.en: Motor power: Electric 10 Series prints 15 kW; Electric 20 prints 22 kW. Theoretical output: Electric 10 Series prints 21 m³/h; Electric 20 prints 8–10 m³/h. Max. outlet pressure: Electric 10 Series prints 23 MPa; Electric 20 prints 10 MPa. Hopper capacity: Electric 10 Series prints 0.1 m³; Electric 20 prints 0.25 m³. Max. aggregate size: Electric 10 Series prints 2 cm and below; Electric 20 prints 1–2 cm. Dimensions: Electric 10 Series prints 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm; Electric 20 prints 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 电机功率：电动10系列印 15 kW；电动20印 22 kW。理论输送量：电动10系列印 21 m³/h；电动20印 8–10 m³/h。最大出口压力：电动10系列印 23 MPa；电动20印 10 MPa。料斗容积：电动10系列印 0.1 m³；电动20印 0.25 m³。最大骨料粒径：电动10系列印 2 cm and below；电动20印 1–2 cm。外形尺寸：电动10系列印 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm；电动20印 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Electric 10 Series prints cells that Electric 20 does not: Horizontal pumping distance 25 m. Electric 20 prints cells that Electric 10 Series does not: Pumping distance (H / V) 120 m / 40 m; Delivery pipe diameter 80 mm. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 电动10系列有、电动20没有的行：水平输送距离 25 m。电动20有、电动10系列没有的行：输送距离（水平/垂直） 120 m / 40 m；输送管内径 80 mm。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: Compare output and distance as separate columns. One does not imply the other. Open /en/products/electric-10-series-concrete-pump/ for Electric 10 Series and /en/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/ for Electric 20. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 产量和距离是两列。一列高并不表示另一列也高。看电动10系列请打开 /zh/products/electric-10-series-concrete-pump/，看电动20请打开 /zh/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric 10 Series print the same motor power as Electric 20?
question.zh: 电动10系列和电动20的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 10 Series prints 15 kW. Electric 20 prints 22 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动10系列印 15 kW。电动20印 22 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 10 Series print the same theoretical output as Electric 20?
question.zh: 电动10系列和电动20的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 10 Series prints 21 m³/h. Electric 20 prints 8–10 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动10系列印 21 m³/h。电动20印 8–10 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 10 Series print the same max. outlet pressure as Electric 20?
question.zh: 电动10系列和电动20的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 10 Series prints 23 MPa. Electric 20 prints 10 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动10系列印 23 MPa。电动20印 10 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is horizontal pumping distance missing on Electric 20?
question.zh: 为什么电动20没有水平输送距离？

answer.en: The Electric 20 page does not print that label. Electric 10 Series prints 25 m. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 电动20这一页没有印这个标题。电动10系列印的是 25 m。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
